title: Working the Last Round in the Quarter for tips
summary: Played nights at a Quarter joint; the salary was tiny but tips of four or five dollars a night made it worthwhile.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: We used to go to work at 10, knock off at 5, 6, 7 o'clock in the morning. Wasn't making what a dollar a night. Plus Tips.
Well, it was a good name for the joint. Yeah, it was a good joint. We made it pretty good.
Our Tips used to be four or five dollars a night apiece. We had a piece, Tips. We made it over.
That's for the whole band or a piece? A piece.
